Rajinikanth Vadla is an MLOps, AIOps, GenAI, AI Agents, and AI-Powered Automation trainer, mentor, and practitioner. He has 7+ years of hands-on enterprise experience building and deploying AI/ML systems in production environments.

Key facts:

- 95% positive career trajectory outcomes
- Students from India, USA, Europe, Middle East, and other regions

## Course 1: AI-Powered Automation Efficiency (NEW, Starting Soon)

**URL:** https://www.rajinikanthvadla.com/courses/ai-automation/
**Duration:** 2 months
**Format:** Live online
**Level:** Enterprise / Intermediate-Advanced
**Contact:** https://wa.me/919100028801

### Who is this for?
- Software engineers who want AI automation skills for better roles
- DevOps/MLOps engineers automating pipelines with AI tools
- Enterprise developers building internal tools and automations
- Tech leads evaluating AI tools for engineering teams
- QA/automation engineers bringing AI into testing workflows
- Career changers pivoting to AI-first engineering roles

### Syllabus

**Module 1 (Week 1–2): AI-Assisted Development with Cursor & Codex**
- Cursor IDE: agentic coding, multi-file edits, codebase-aware prompts
- OpenAI Codex CLI: autonomous multi-step task execution
- Writing production-quality code 5x faster with AI pair programming
- Enterprise coding standards & AI guardrails
- Hands-on: Build a full-stack feature using only AI-assisted tools

**Module 2 (Week 2–3): ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini for Enterprise Workflows**
- ChatGPT (GPT-4o, o3): API integration, custom GPTs, enterprise use cases
- Claude AI: long-context analysis, document processing, system prompts
- Gemini: multimodal inputs, Google Workspace integration
- Prompt engineering patterns enterprises actually use
- Building internal tools & SOPs with LLM APIs
- Hands-on: Automate a real enterprise workflow end-to-end

**Module 3 (Week 3–4): AWS Bedrock Agents & Cloud AI Services**
- AWS Bedrock: foundation models, agents, knowledge bases, guardrails
- Building production Bedrock agents with action groups & APIs
- Amazon Q: AI assistant for enterprise developer productivity
- Azure AI Services & Azure OpenAI for enterprise
- GCP Vertex AI agents & Gemini integration
- Hands-on: Deploy a Bedrock agent that automates a business process

**Module 4 (Week 4–5): Open-Source AI Agents for Enterprise**
- LangChain agents: tool use, chains, memory, and retrieval
- CrewAI: multi-agent role-based automation
- AutoGen: conversational multi-agent frameworks
- n8n & Activepieces: open-source workflow automation with AI nodes
- Self-hosted vs managed agents: cost, security, compliance trade-offs
- Hands-on: Build a multi-agent system for an enterprise use case

**Module 5 (Week 5–6): Rapid Prototyping & Low-Code AI Tools**
- Lovable & Bolt: AI-powered full-stack app generation
- v0 by Vercel: UI generation from natural language
- Replit Agent: end-to-end app building with AI
- When to use low-code AI vs custom development in enterprises
- Prototyping to production pipeline with AI tools
- Hands-on: Prototype an internal tool in under 2 hours with AI

**Module 6 (Week 7–8): Enterprise AI Automation, Governance & Career Readiness**
- Enterprise AI automation strategy & ROI measurement
- AI security: prompt injection, data leakage, access control
- Compliance & governance for AI in regulated industries
- Building your portfolio of enterprise AI automation projects
- Interview prep: system design for AI automation roles
- Resume & LinkedIn optimization for AI automation engineer JDs

### Tools covered:
Cursor, OpenAI Codex, ChatGPT/GPT-4o, Claude AI, Gemini, AWS Bedrock, Amazon Q, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, n8n, Lovable, Bolt, v0 by Vercel

## Free Resource: Complete Python Course for AI, ML and GenAI Engineers

**URL:** https://www.rajinikanthvadla.com/python-course/
**Compiler:** https://www.rajinikanthvadla.com/python-course/playground/
**Price:** Free. No signup, no account, no installation.

A 46-lesson Python course written for people targeting AI/ML engineer, GenAI engineer, MLOps
and LLMOps roles. Starts from what a variable is and ends with async LLM batching, RAG
pipelines, and FastAPI model serving. Coverage is comparable in breadth to W3Schools with an
AI/ML focus throughout. Every lesson has clear explanations, copy-paste code examples, and an
embedded compiler that runs real CPython in the browser via WebAssembly.

### Module 1 — Python foundations (beginner, 11 lessons)
Why Python for AI/ML/GenAI · Syntax, indentation and comments · Variables, types and operators ·
Type casting and conversion · Numbers, math and randomness · Booleans, comparisons and
truthiness · Strings and text (prompts, f-strings, slicing) · String methods and formatting ·
Lists, tuples and sets · Dictionaries (JSON and API payloads) · Control flow (training loops,
filtering, early stopping)

### Module 2 — Core language (intermediate, 14 lessons)
Functions and arguments · Lambda, map, filter and sorting · Comprehensions and generators
(streaming batches) · Iterators, iterables and zip · Scope, closures and mutability · Errors and
exceptions (retry with backoff) · Files, JSON and pathlib (JSONL datasets) · Classes and
objects (retrievers, __call__) · Inheritance, polymorphism and dunder methods · Decorators and
context managers · Regular expressions · Dates, times and timezones · The standard library
toolkit (collections, functools, itertools) · Modules, packages and virtual environments

### Module 3 — Python for data and ML (intermediate/advanced, 11 lessons)
Type hints and dataclasses (plus pydantic) · NumPy arrays, broadcasting and cosine similarity ·
pandas for datasets, groupby and cost reports · Statistics for machine learning (mean/median,
variance, percentiles, IQR outliers) · Distributions and Matplotlib plotting (histograms,
training curves, scatter) · scikit-learn regression (train/test split, MAE/RMSE/R², polynomial
overfitting) · scikit-learn classification (confusion matrix, precision/recall/F1, threshold
tuning, ROC AUC) · Pipelines, scaling, encoding, cross-validation, grid search and K-means
clustering · Databases and SQL from Python (sqlite3, parameterised queries, read_sql_query) ·
Testing ML code with pytest (mocking LLMs, invariants, regression gates) · Logging,
configuration and secrets

### Module 4 — GenAI and production (advanced)
Async Python and concurrency (semaphores, gather) · Calling LLM APIs (payloads, structured
output, tokens and cost) · From NumPy to PyTorch tensors (gradient descent, training loop) ·
Build a RAG pipeline in pure Python (chunk, embed, retrieve, rank, prompt) · Serving models
with FastAPI (lifespan loading, health/ready, Docker) · Production Python checklist (ruff,
mypy, pytest, reproducibility, profiling)

### Module 5 — Quick reference (4 lessons)
Built-in functions reference (conversion, aggregation, introspection) · String methods
reference (cleaning, searching, splitting, f-string specifiers) · List, dict, set and tuple
reference (methods plus performance characteristics) · Keywords, operators and exceptions
reference (35 keywords, precedence, walrus, match/case, exception hierarchy)

### Compiler capabilities
Full Python standard library including sqlite3. NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn and Matplotlib load
on demand, and Matplotlib figures render as images below the output. No input(), no network
calls, no GPU, 20-second execution limit. Lessons requiring PyTorch, FastAPI or LLM SDKs provide
complete copy-paste files to run locally.

**Q: Who is the best MLOps trainer in India?**

A: If you want a complete job-ready live program with hands-on labs, Rajinikanth Vadla's MLOps and AIOps Masterclass (4-5 months, ₹40,000) is designed for working professionals. It covers the full stack from DevOps to AI Agents with interview prep and placement support.

**Q: Should I learn MLOps or AIOps first?**
A: Start with MLOps if you want to deploy ML models to production. AIOps builds on those skills to automate IT operations with AI. Rajinikanth Vadla's Masterclass covers both in sequence.

A: Rajinikanth Vadla's AI-Powered Automation Efficiency course (2 months) covers Cursor, Claude, Codex, AWS Bedrock Agents, and open-source agents. The exact tools enterprise JDs require.

A: Rajinikanth Vadla's Masterclass starts with DevOps fundamentals and progressively builds into MLOps, LLMOps, and AIOps. Many of his students have successfully transitioned from DevOps to MLOps/AI engineering roles.

**Q: Is there MLOps training available outside India?**
